name: IwaiCosmo Holdings, Inc.
summary: IwaiCosmo Holdings, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides financial services using information technology in Japan. It also offers asset management services to individual investors. The company also provides financial instruments transactions such as the buying and selling of securities, as well as underwriting and secondary distribution of securities. The company was formerly known as Iwai Securities Co., Ltd. and changed its name to IwaiCosmo Holdings, Inc. in July 2010. IwaiCosmo Holdings, Inc. was incorporated in 1944 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
